ChangeNotes.Value: v1.3.0 - THE WALLS AND SAILS UPDATE. Two new drill grounds. CASTLES: at your own castle the muster becomes a SIEGE drill (its own option on the castle menu) - storm your own walls or hold them, on the castle's real scene at its true wall level. The garrison and militia stand with the defense, your ENGINEER's skill unlocks the siege equipment in tiers (both sides armed on your purse), a grand muster costs more, keeps a per-castle clock, and earns a little renown and influence. The mock enemy comes to the walls too - phantoms besiege you when you hold, reinforce the garrison when you storm. THE SEA (War Sails): divide the fleet AT YOUR WORD through the new ship-divide window (or let it follow the men - every hull comes home either way); the phantom SHIPYARD lays down the mock enemy's fleet, any culture's hulls, fitted as you please; and the scout ride SAILS - take the flagship out with your crew, no battle, no cost, hull home without a scratch. THE YARD: your STEWARD speeds the drill cooldown, and your best-fighting companions INSTRUCT, adding to the XP kept. Plus the fixes the playtests earned: the siege auto-resolve now truly fights on the walls, no post-battle menu can restart a drill or mint prisoners, and phantom casualties no longer inflate your own losses.
